name: Astrid Halvorsen
bio: Astrid's journey into motorsport began unconventionally, not through racing herself, but through a deep fascination with the engineering underpinning it all. After completing her master's in mechanical engineering, she initially worked in the automotive industry, quickly realizing her passion lay in pushing boundaries rather than mass production. She transitioned to motorsport, drawn by the constant innovation and the relentless pursuit of performance. At Walkenhorst Motorsport, Astrid coordinates the test driver program, meticulously planning schedules, analyzing data, and identifying areas for improvement. Her approach is data-driven and analytical, always seeking marginal gains through rigorous testing and feedback. Astrid's sharp eye for detail and ability to translate complex technical data into actionable insights make her a valuable asset to the team.

physical.hairStyle: Long, braided and usually tied back during work, with some strands escaping
physical.description: Astrid is a slender woman with a focused gaze and a practical, no-nonsense demeanor.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with technical diagrams and observations.
Has a habit of tapping her pen against her teeth when deep in thought.
Prefers to conduct meetings standing up, claiming it helps her think more clearly.
